response.answer: Giving plants breathing room by spacing and pruning to improve airflow helps prevent powdery mildew. This reduces the still, humid microclimate where the disease commonly builds up. Additionally, choosing resistant plant varieties and clearing affected plant debris at the end of the season can help prevent recurrence.
